title: iRacing Mustang GT3 COTA Guide 2:04.8 Ford Mustang GT3 Circuit Of The Americas Track Guide

corners.braking: Midway between 150 and 100, brake late, 55% to second, then first

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: Flat, get on brakes at rumble strip, 25% trail off
corners.line: Flat left side, left front tires on track
corners.exit: Flat until left side, then get on gas 100%

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Get on brakes at apex, 10-15% long trail off
brakes to about 10% before asphalt goes from dark to light
corners.exit: start picking back up on the gas

corners.braking: brakes to about 15% before the walkway
corners.exit: start picking back up on the gas

corners.braking: brakes to about 60% alongside the orange marshal's inlet
corners.exit: back on the gas at the apex

corners.braking: Brake at 170 marker, 55-60% to first gear
corners.line: Trail off, turn in, apex on left side

corners.braking: Brake at white line, 35-40% to first gear
corners.line: Trail off, turn in, apex on right side

corners.braking: Brake to 55-60%, trail off to 1st gear
corners.line: Cut the corner, left tires on curb, right tires on track
corners.mistakes: Do not use F1 start finish line

general_tips: Get car over the edge for turn two
go flat through the kink of turn 10
Good throttle and brake control is rewarded
